legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access HOME GLOSSARY PPN 002 BACK TO GLOSSARY PPN 002 Procurement Policy Note 002. UK Cabinet Office policy. Sets a mandatory minimum 10% social value weighting on central government contract evaluations. TL;DR → What it is: UK Cabinet Office rule (Feb 2025) on social value in bids. → The 10% rule: at least 10% of the evaluation score goes to social value. → How you score it: the TOMs framework with National TOMs 2023-24 proxy values. Procurement Policy Note 002 (February 2025) is a UK Cabinet Office instruction. All central government departments, their executive agencies, and non-departmental public bodies must allocate a minimum 10% weighting of the total contract evaluation score to social value. PPN 002 applies to new procurements. Contracts initiated under PPN 06/20 stay on the earlier framework. The 5 PPN 002 missions 1. Fighting climate change: carbon reduction, waste minimisation, sustainable procurement. 2. Tackling economic inequality: SME supply-chain access, skills development, fair work. 3. Equal opportunity: inclusive employment, disability representation, progression pathways. 4. Wellbeing: community integration, mental health, workforce wellbeing. 5. Covid-19 recovery: (legacy mission, reducing in relevance as recovery progresses). Key facts Minimum weighting: 10% of total evaluation score (buyers can set higher). Scoring framework: TOMs (Themes, Outcomes, Measures). Proxy values: National TOMs 2023-24 is the canonical reference. Scope: new central government contracts from February 2025. Relation to PPN 06/20: PPN 002 builds on and supersedes PPN 06/20 (September 2020) for new contracts; PPN 06/20 continues to apply to contracts initiated under its regime. How CrowAgent uses this term CrowMark applies the PPN 002 rules-based mission mapping deterministically, not through AI. The flow is: contract profile, then mission selection, then TOMs measure recommendations, then National TOMs 2023-24 proxy-value scoring, then AI-assisted narrative generation. Every score traces back to a TOMs measure and an National TOMs entry. Read more PPN 002 complete guide → missions, scoring methodology, common mistakes, and evidence requirements.
